ayat-al-kursi.arabic:
أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
ayat-al-kursi.transliteration: Aʿūdhu billāhi minash-shayṭānir-rajīm. Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwal-ḥayyul-qayyūm, lā taʾkhudhuhu sinatun wa lā nawm, lahu mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍ, man dhal-ladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahu illā bi-idhnih, yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wa mā khalfahum, wa lā yuḥīṭūna bi-shayʾin min ʿilmihi illā bi-mā shāʾ, wasiʿa kursiyyuhus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, wa lā yaʾūduhu ḥifẓuhumā, wa huwal-ʿaliyyul-ʿaẓīm.
ayat-al-kursi.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan. Allah: there is no god except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Drowsiness does not come over Him, nor does sleep. All that is in the heavens and all that is on the earth is His. Who is there that can intercede before Him except by His leave? He knows what lies ahead of them and what lies behind them, while they grasp nothing of His knowledge beyond what He wills. His Kursi encompasses the heavens and the earth, and safeguarding them both is no burden to Him. He is the Most High, the Magnificent.

virtue.en: Whoever says it in the morning is protected from the jinn until evening, and whoever says it in the evening is protected from them until morning.
virtue.ar: من قالها حين يصبح أُجير من الجن حتى يمسي، ومن قالها حين يمسي أُجير منهم حتى يصبح

reference.en: Qur'an, Surah al-Baqarah, ayah 255. Al-Hakim 1/562; graded authentic by al-Albani in Sahih at-Targhib wat-Tarhib 1/273, who attributed it to an-Nasa'i and at-Tabarani and said that at-Tabarani's chain is good
reference.ar: سورة البقرة، الآية: 255. أخرجه الحاكم، 1/562، وصححه الألباني في صحيح الترغيب والترهيب، 1/273، وعزاه إلى النسائي، والطبراني، وقال: ((إسناد الطبراني جيد))

al-ikhlas-al-falaq-an-nas.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ
لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ
مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ
وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
مَلِكِ النَّاسِ
إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ
مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ
الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ
مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
al-ikhlas-al-falaq-an-nas.transliteration: Bismillāhir-raḥmānir-raḥīm. Qul huwallāhu aḥad, Allāhuṣ-ṣamad, lam yalid wa lam yūlad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan aḥad. Bismillāhir-raḥmānir-raḥīm. Qul aʿūdhu bi-rabbil-falaq, min sharri mā khalaq, wa min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab, wa min sharrin-naffāthāti fil-ʿuqad, wa min sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad. Bismillāhir-raḥmānir-raḥīm. Qul aʿūdhu bi-rabbin-nās, malikin-nās, ilāhin-nās, min sharril-waswāsil-khannās, alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūrin-nās, minal-jinnati wan-nās.
al-ikhlas-al-falaq-an-nas.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: He is Allah, the One; Allah, the Self-Sufficient on whom all depend. He begot no one, nor was He begotten, and there is no one comparable to Him. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the dawn from the evil of whatever He has created, from the evil of the night's darkness when it sets in, from the evil of those who blow upon knots, and from the evil of an envious one when he envies. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of humankind, the King of humankind, the God of humankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer who whispers into the breasts of humankind, whether of the jinn or of humankind.

virtue.en: For whoever says them three times in the morning and in the evening, they suffice against everything.
virtue.ar: من قالها ثلاث مرات حين يصبح وحين يمسي كفته من كل شيء

reference.en: Qur'an, Surahs al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq and an-Nas. Abu Dawud 4/322 (no. 5082); at-Tirmidhi 5/567 (no. 3575); see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/182
reference.ar: سورة الإخلاص، سورة الفلق، سورة الناس. أخرجه أبو داود، 4/322، برقم 5082، والترمذي، 5/567، برقم 3575، وانظر: صحيح الترمذي، 3/182

morning-asbahna-wa-asbaha-al-mulk.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ المُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا اليَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا اليَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي القَبْرِ
morning-asbahna-wa-asbaha-al-mulk.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥal-mulku lillāh, wal-ḥamdu lillāh, lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. Rabbi asʾaluka khayra mā fī hādhal-yawmi wa khayra mā baʿdah, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fī hādhal-yawmi wa sharri mā baʿdah. Rabbi aʿūdhu bika minal-kasali wa sūʾil-kibar. Rabbi aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābin fin-nāri wa ʿadhābin fil-qabr.
morning-asbahna-wa-asbaha-al-mulk.translation: We have entered the morning, and the dominion this morning is Allah's, and all praise is due to Allah. There is no god but Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of what is in this day and the good of what comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of what is in this day and the evil of what comes after it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and from the ills of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from torment in the Fire and torment in the grave.

reference.ar: مسلم، 4/2088، برقم 2723

evening-amsayna-wa-amsa-al-mulk.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى المُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي القَبْرِ
evening-amsayna-wa-amsa-al-mulk.transliteration: Amsaynā wa amsal-mulku lillāh, wal-ḥamdu lillāh, lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. Rabbi asʾaluka khayra mā fī hādhihil-laylati wa khayra mā baʿdahā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fī hādhihil-laylati wa sharri mā baʿdahā. Rabbi aʿūdhu bika minal-kasali wa sūʾil-kibar. Rabbi aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābin fin-nāri wa ʿadhābin fil-qabr.
evening-amsayna-wa-amsa-al-mulk.translation: We have entered the evening, and the dominion this evening is Allah's, and all praise is due to Allah. There is no god but Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of what is in this night and the good of what comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of what is in this night and the evil of what comes after it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and from the ills of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from torment in the Fire and torment in the grave.

reference.ar: مسلم، 4/2088، برقم 2723

morning-allahumma-bika-asbahna.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
morning-allahumma-bika-asbahna.transliteration: Allāhumma bika aṣbaḥnā, wa bika amsaynā, wa bika naḥyā, wa bika namūtu, wa ilaykan-nushūr.
morning-allahumma-bika-asbahna.translation: O Allah, it is through You that we have reached the morning and through You that we reach the evening; through You we live and through You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi 5/466 (no. 3391), whose narration has the two endings the other way round; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/142. With the ending recited here: al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad (no. 1199); Abu Dawud (no. 5068)
reference.ar: الترمذي، 5/466، برقم 3391، وانظر: صحيح الترمذي 3/142. والبخاري في الأدب المفرد، برقم 1199، وأبو داود، برقم 5068

evening-allahumma-bika-amsayna.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ المَصِيرُ
evening-allahumma-bika-amsayna.transliteration: Allāhumma bika amsaynā, wa bika aṣbaḥnā, wa bika naḥyā, wa bika namūtu, wa ilaykal-maṣīr.
evening-allahumma-bika-amsayna.translation: O Allah, it is through You that we have reached the evening and through You that we reach the morning; through You we live and through You we die, and to You is the final return.

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi 5/466 (no. 3391), whose narration has the two endings the other way round; see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/142. With the ending recited here: al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad (no. 1199); Ibn Majah (no. 3868)
reference.ar: الترمذي، 5/466، برقم 3391، وانظر: صحيح الترمذي 3/142. والبخاري في الأدب المفرد، برقم 1199، وابن ماجه، برقم 3868

sayyid-al-istighfar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
sayyid-al-istighfar.transliteration: Allāhumma anta rabbī lā ilāha illā ant, khalaqtanī wa anā ʿabduk, wa anā ʿalā ʿahdika wa waʿdika mastaṭaʿt, aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣanaʿt, abūʾu laka bi-niʿmatika ʿalayy, wa abūʾu bi-dhanbī, faghfir lī fa-innahu lā yaghfirudh-dhunūba illā ant.
sayyid-al-istighfar.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I hold to Your covenant and Your promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of whatever I have done. I confess to You Your favour upon me, and I confess my sin; so forgive me, for no one forgives sins except You.

virtue.en: Whoever says it in the evening with firm conviction and dies that night enters Paradise, and likewise if it is said in the morning.
virtue.ar: من قالها موقناً بها حين يمسي، فمات من ليلته دخل الجنة، وكذلك إذا أصبح

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 7/150 (no. 6306)
reference.ar: أخرجه البخاري، 7/150، برقم 6306

morning-asbahtu-ushhiduka.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
morning-asbahtu-ushhiduka.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aṣbaḥtu ushhiduka wa ushhidu ḥamalata ʿarshik, wa malāʾikataka wa jamīʿa khalqik, annaka antallāhu lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, wa anna Muḥammadan ʿabduka wa rasūluk.
morning-asbahtu-ushhiduka.translation: O Allah, I have entered the morning calling You to witness, and calling to witness the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels and all Your creation, that You are Allah; there is no god but You, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is Your servant and Your Messenger.

virtue.en: Allah frees from the Fire whoever says it four times in the morning or in the evening.
virtue.ar: من قالها حين يصبح، أو يمسي أربع مرات، أعتقه اللَّه من النار

reference.en: Abu Dawud 4/317 (no. 5069); al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad (no. 1201); an-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah (no. 9); Ibn as-Sunni (no. 70). Ibn Baz graded the chains of an-Nasa'i and Abu Dawud good in Tuhfat al-Akhyar, p. 23
reference.ar: أخرجه أبو داود، 4/317، برقم 5069، والبخاري في الأدب المفرد، برقم 1201، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 9، وابن السني، برقم 70، وحسّن سماحة الشيخ ابن باز - رحمه الله - إسناد النسائي، وأبي داود، في تحفة الأخيار، ص23

evening-amsaytu-ushhiduka.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَمْسَيْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
evening-amsaytu-ushhiduka.transliteration: Allāhumma innī amsaytu ushhiduka wa ushhidu ḥamalata ʿarshik, wa malāʾikataka wa jamīʿa khalqik, annaka antallāhu lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, wa anna Muḥammadan ʿabduka wa rasūluk.
evening-amsaytu-ushhiduka.translation: O Allah, I have entered the evening calling You to witness, and calling to witness the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels and all Your creation, that You are Allah; there is no god but You, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is Your servant and Your Messenger.

virtue.en: Allah frees from the Fire whoever says it four times in the morning or in the evening.
virtue.ar: من قالها حين يصبح، أو يمسي أربع مرات، أعتقه اللَّه من النار

reference.en: Abu Dawud 4/317 (no. 5069); al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad (no. 1201); an-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah (no. 9); Ibn as-Sunni (no. 70). Ibn Baz graded the chains of an-Nasa'i and Abu Dawud good in Tuhfat al-Akhyar, p. 23
reference.ar: أخرجه أبو داود، 4/317، برقم 5069، والبخاري في الأدب المفرد، برقم 1201، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 9، وابن السني، برقم 70، وحسّن سماحة الشيخ ابن باز - رحمه الله - إسناد النسائي، وأبي داود، في تحفة الأخيار، ص23

morning-ma-asbaha-bi-min-nimah.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
morning-ma-asbaha-bi-min-nimah.transliteration: Allāhumma mā aṣbaḥa bī min niʿmatin aw bi-aḥadin min khalqika fa-minka waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, fa-lakal-ḥamdu wa lakash-shukr.
morning-ma-asbaha-bi-min-nimah.translation: O Allah, whatever blessing has come this morning to me or to any of Your creation is from You alone, without partner; so to You belongs all praise and to You belongs all thanks.

virtue.en: Whoever says it in the morning has given the thanks due for that day, and whoever says it in the evening has given the thanks due for that night.
virtue.ar: من قالها حين يصبح فقد أدَّى شكر يومه، ومن قالها حين يمسي فقد أدَّى شكر ليلته

reference.en: Abu Dawud 4/318 (no. 5073); an-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah (no. 7); Ibn as-Sunni (no. 41); Ibn Hibban (Mawarid, no. 2361). Ibn Baz graded its chain good in Tuhfat al-Akhyar, p. 24
reference.ar: أخرجه أبو داود، 4/318، برقم 5073، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 7، وابن السني، برقم 41، وابن حبان، ((موارد)) برقم 2361، وحسّن ابن باز - رحمه الله - إسناده في تحفة الأخيار، ص24

evening-ma-amsa-bi-min-nimah.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَى بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
evening-ma-amsa-bi-min-nimah.transliteration: Allāhumma mā amsā bī min niʿmatin aw bi-aḥadin min khalqika fa-minka waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, fa-lakal-ḥamdu wa lakash-shukr.
evening-ma-amsa-bi-min-nimah.translation: O Allah, whatever blessing has come this evening to me or to any of Your creation is from You alone, without partner; so to You belongs all praise and to You belongs all thanks.

virtue.en: Whoever says it in the morning has given the thanks due for that day, and whoever says it in the evening has given the thanks due for that night.
virtue.ar: من قالها حين يصبح فقد أدَّى شكر يومه، ومن قالها حين يمسي فقد أدَّى شكر ليلته

reference.en: Abu Dawud 4/318 (no. 5073); an-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah (no. 7); Ibn as-Sunni (no. 41); Ibn Hibban (Mawarid, no. 2361). Ibn Baz graded its chain good in Tuhfat al-Akhyar, p. 24
reference.ar: أخرجه أبو داود، 4/318، برقم 5073، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 7، وابن السني، برقم 41، وابن حبان، ((موارد)) برقم 2361، وحسّن ابن باز - رحمه الله - إسناده في تحفة الأخيار، ص24

allahumma-afini-fi-badani.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الكُفْرِ، وَالفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
allahumma-afini-fi-badani.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī badanī, Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī samʿī, Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī baṣarī, lā ilāha illā ant. Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr, wa aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābil-qabr, lā ilāha illā ant.
allahumma-afini-fi-badani.translation: O Allah, grant me soundness in my body. O Allah, grant me soundness in my hearing. O Allah, grant me soundness in my sight. There is no god but You. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and from poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the torment of the grave. There is no god but You.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 4/324 (no. 5090); Ahmad 5/42 (no. 20430); an-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah (no. 22); Ibn as-Sunni (no. 69); al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad (no. 701). Ibn Baz graded its chain good in Tuhfat al-Akhyar, p. 26
reference.ar: أبو داود، 4/324، برقم 5090، وأحمد، 5/42، برقم 20430، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 22، وابن السني، برقم 69، والبخاري في الأدب المفرد، برقم 701، وحسّن العلامة ابن باز - رحمه الله - إسناده في تحفة الأخيار، ص26

hasbiyallahu-la-ilaha-illa-huwa.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ العَرْشِ العَظِيمِ
hasbiyallahu-la-ilaha-illa-huwa.transliteration: Ḥasbiyallāhu lā ilāha illā huwa, ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbul-ʿarshil-ʿaẓīm.
hasbiyallahu-la-ilaha-illa-huwa.translation: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god but He. In Him I have put my trust, and He is the Lord of the mighty Throne.

virtue.en: Whoever says it seven times in the morning and in the evening, Allah takes care of whatever worries them in the matters of this world and the Hereafter.
virtue.ar: من قالها حين يصبح وحين يمسي سبع مرات كفاه اللَّه ما أهمّه من أمر الدنيا والآخرة

reference.en: Its words are the close of ayah 129 of Surah at-Tawbah in the Qur'an. Ibn as-Sunni (no. 71), as a saying of the Prophet; Abu Dawud 4/321 (no. 5081), as a saying of a Companion; its chain was graded authentic by Shu'ayb and Abd al-Qadir al-Arna'ut. See Zad al-Ma'ad 2/376
reference.ar: سورة التوبة، الآية: 129. أخرجه ابن السني، برقم 71 مرفوعاً، وأبو داود موقوفاً، 4/321، برقم 5081، وصحّح إسناده شعيب وعبد القادر الأرناؤوط. انظر: زاد المعاد 2/376

allahumma-inni-asaluka-al-afwa-wal-afiya.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ العَفْوَ وَالعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ العَفْوَ وَالعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
allahumma-inni-asaluka-al-afwa-wal-afiya.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾalukal-ʿafwa wal-ʿāfiyata fid-dunyā wal-ākhirah. Allāhumma innī asʾalukal-ʿafwa wal-ʿāfiyata fī dīnī wa dunyāya wa ahlī wa mālī. Allāhummastur ʿawrātī wa āmin rawʿātī. Allāhummaḥfaẓnī min bayni yadayya wa min khalfī, wa ʿan yamīnī wa ʿan shimālī, wa min fawqī, wa aʿūdhu bi-ʿaẓamatika an ughtāla min taḥtī.
allahumma-inni-asaluka-al-afwa-wal-afiya.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion and my worldly life, and in my family and my property. O Allah, cover my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, protect me from the front and from behind, on my right and on my left, and from above, and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being seized unawares from beneath me.

reference.en: Abu Dawud (no. 5074); Ibn Majah (no. 3871); see also Sahih Ibn Majah 2/332
reference.ar: أبو داود، برقم 5074، وابن ماجه، برقم 3871، وانظر: صحيح ابن ماجه، 2/332

allahumma-alim-al-ghayb-wash-shahadah.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
allahumma-alim-al-ghayb-wash-shahadah.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿālimal-ghaybi wash-shahādah, fāṭiras-samāwāti wal-arḍ, rabba kulli shayʾin wa malīkah, ashhadu an lā ilāha illā ant, aʿūdhu bika min sharri nafsī, wa min sharrish-shayṭāni wa shirkih, wa an aqtarifa ʿalā nafsī sūʾan aw ajurrahu ilā muslim.
allahumma-alim-al-ghayb-wash-shahadah.translation: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Possessor of everything: I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own self, from the evil of Satan and his call to associate partners with You, and from committing any wrong against myself or bringing it upon a Muslim.

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi (nos. 3392 and 3529); Abu Dawud (no. 5067); see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/142
reference.ar: الترمذي، برقم 3392، ورقم 3529، وأبو داود، برقم 5067، وانظر: صحيح الترمذي، 3/142

bismillah-alladhi-la-yadurru.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ العَلِيمُ
bismillah-alladhi-la-yadurru.transliteration: Bismillāhil-ladhī lā yaḍurru maʿasmihi shayʾun fil-arḍi wa lā fis-samāʾi wa huwas-samīʿul-ʿalīm.
bismillah-alladhi-la-yadurru.translation: In the name of Allah, alongside whose name nothing in the earth or in the sky can do any harm; and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

virtue.en: Nothing harms whoever says it three times in the morning and three times in the evening.
virtue.ar: من قالها ثلاثاً إذا أصبح، وثلاثاً إذا أمسى لم يضره شيء

reference.en: Abu Dawud 4/323 (no. 5088); at-Tirmidhi 5/465 (no. 3388); Ibn Majah (no. 3869); Ahmad (no. 446). See also Sahih Ibn Majah 2/332; Ibn Baz graded its chain good in Tuhfat al-Akhyar, p. 39
reference.ar: أخرجه أبو داود، 4/323، برقم 5088، والترمذي، 5/465، برقم 3388، وابن ماجه، برقم 3869، وأحمد، برقم 446. وانظر: صحيح ابن ماجه، 2/332، وحسّن إسناده العلامة ابن باز - رحمه الله - في تحفة الأخيار، ص39

raditu-billahi-rabban.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
raditu-billahi-rabban.transliteration: Raḍītu billāhi rabbā, wa bil-islāmi dīnā, wa bi-Muḥammadin ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallama nabiyyā.
raditu-billahi-rabban.translation: I am content with Allah as Lord, with Islam as religion, and with Muhammad, may Allah's blessings and peace be upon him, as Prophet.

virtue.en: Whoever says it three times in the morning and three times in the evening, Allah has taken it upon Himself to please them on the Day of Resurrection.
virtue.ar: من قالها ثلاثاً حين يصبح وثلاثاً حين يمسي كان حقاً على اللَّه أن يرضيه يوم القيامة

reference.en: Ahmad 4/337 (no. 18967); an-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah (no. 4); Ibn as-Sunni (no. 68); Abu Dawud 4/318 (no. 5072); at-Tirmidhi 5/465 (no. 3389). Ibn Baz graded it good in Tuhfat al-Akhyar, p. 39
reference.ar: أحمد، 4/337، برقم 18967، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 4، وابن السني، برقم 68، وأبو داود، 4/318، برقم 5072، والترمذي، 5/465، برقم 3389، وحسّنه ابن باز - رحمه الله - في تحفة الأخيار ص39

ya-hayyu-ya-qayyum.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
ya-hayyu-ya-qayyum.transliteration: Yā ḥayyu yā qayyūm, bi-raḥmatika astaghīth, aṣliḥ lī shaʾnī kullah, wa lā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata ʿayn.
ya-hayyu-ya-qayyum.translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all, in Your mercy I seek relief. Set right all my affairs for me, and do not leave me to my own self, even for the blink of an eye.

reference.en: Al-Hakim 1/545, who graded it authentic, and adh-Dhahabi agreed; see also Sahih at-Targhib wat-Tarhib 1/273
reference.ar: الحاكم وصححه، ووافقه الذهبي، 1/545، وانظر: صحيح الترغيب والترهيب، 1/273

morning-asbahna-rabbil-alamin.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ المُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا اليَوْمِ: فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنُورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
morning-asbahna-rabbil-alamin.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥal-mulku lillāhi rabbil-ʿālamīn. Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayra hādhal-yawm: fatḥahu, wa naṣrahu, wa nūrahu, wa barakatahu, wa hudāh, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fīhi wa sharri mā baʿdah.
morning-asbahna-rabbil-alamin.translation: We have entered the morning, and the dominion this morning is Allah's, the Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for this day's good: its triumph, its help and its light, its blessing and its guidance; and I seek refuge in You from the evil that is in it and the evil that follows it.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 4/322 (no. 5084); its chain was graded good by Shu'ayb and Abd al-Qadir al-Arna'ut in their edition of Zad al-Ma'ad 2/373
reference.ar: أبو داود، 4/322، برقم 5084، وحسن إسناده شعيب وعبد القادر الأرناؤوط في تحقيق زاد المعاد، 2/373

evening-amsayna-rabbil-alamin.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى المُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ: فَتْحَهَا، وَنَصْرَهَا، وَنُورَهَا، وَبَرَكَتَهَا، وَهُدَاهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهَا وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
evening-amsayna-rabbil-alamin.transliteration: Amsaynā wa amsal-mulku lillāhi rabbil-ʿālamīn. Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayra hādhihil-laylah: fatḥahā, wa naṣrahā, wa nūrahā, wa barakatahā, wa hudāhā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fīhā wa sharri mā baʿdahā.
evening-amsayna-rabbil-alamin.translation: We have entered the evening, and the dominion this evening is Allah's, the Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for this night's good: its triumph, its help and its light, its blessing and its guidance; and I seek refuge in You from the evil that is in it and the evil that follows it.

reference.en: Abu Dawud 4/322 (no. 5084); its chain was graded good by Shu'ayb and Abd al-Qadir al-Arna'ut in their edition of Zad al-Ma'ad 2/373
reference.ar: أبو داود، 4/322، برقم 5084، وحسن إسناده شعيب وعبد القادر الأرناؤوط في تحقيق زاد المعاد، 2/373

morning-asbahna-ala-fitrat-al-islam.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الإِسْلَامِ وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ المُشْرِكِينَ
morning-asbahna-ala-fitrat-al-islam.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā ʿalā fiṭratil-islām, wa ʿalā kalimatil-ikhlāṣ, wa ʿalā dīni nabiyyinā Muḥammadin ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam, wa ʿalā millati abīnā Ibrāhīma ḥanīfan musliman wa mā kāna minal-mushrikīn.
morning-asbahna-ala-fitrat-al-islam.translation: We have entered the morning upon the natural way of Islam, upon the word of sincere devotion, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad, may Allah's blessings and peace be upon him, and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, who was upright in faith, a Muslim, and was not one of those who associate partners with Allah.

reference.en: Ahmad 3/406 and 407 (nos. 15360 and 15363); Ibn as-Sunni in 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah (no. 34); see also Sahih al-Jami' 4/209
reference.ar: أحمد، 3/406، و407، برقم 15360، ورقم 15363، وابن السني في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 34، وانظر: صحيح الجامع، 4/209

evening-amsayna-ala-fitrat-al-islam.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الإِسْلَامِ وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ المُشْرِكِينَ
evening-amsayna-ala-fitrat-al-islam.transliteration: Amsaynā ʿalā fiṭratil-islām, wa ʿalā kalimatil-ikhlāṣ, wa ʿalā dīni nabiyyinā Muḥammadin ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam, wa ʿalā millati abīnā Ibrāhīma ḥanīfan musliman wa mā kāna minal-mushrikīn.
evening-amsayna-ala-fitrat-al-islam.translation: We have entered the evening upon the natural way of Islam, upon the word of sincere devotion, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad, may Allah's blessings and peace be upon him, and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, who was upright in faith, a Muslim, and was not one of those who associate partners with Allah.

reference.en: Ahmad 3/406 and 407 (nos. 15360 and 15363); Ibn as-Sunni in 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah (no. 34); see also Sahih al-Jami' 4/209
reference.ar: أحمد، 3/406، و407، برقم 15360، ورقم 15363، وابن السني في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 34، وانظر: صحيح الجامع، 4/209

subhanallahi-wa-bihamdih.translation: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him.

virtue.en: Whoever says it one hundred times in the morning and in the evening, no one will come on the Day of Resurrection with anything better than what they bring, except someone who said the same or more.
virtue.ar: من قالها مائة مرة حين يصبح وحين يمسي لم يأت أحد يوم القيامة بأفضل مما جاء به إلا أحد قال مثل ما قال أو زاد عليه

reference.ar: مسلم، 4/2071، برقم 2692

la-ilaha-illallah-wahdahu-ten-times.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
la-ilaha-illallah-wahdahu-ten-times.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.
la-ilaha-illallah-wahdahu-ten-times.translation: There is no god but Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things.

note.en: Ten times, or once when overcome by laziness.
note.ar: عشرَ مرَّات، أَوْ مرَّةً واحدةً عندَ الكَسَلِ

reference.en: Ten times: an-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah (no. 24); Ahmad (no. 8719); see also Sahih at-Targhib wat-Tarhib 1/272 and Tuhfat al-Akhyar by Ibn Baz, p. 44. Once, when lazy: Abu Dawud (no. 5077); Ibn Majah (no. 3867); Ahmad (no. 16583); see also Sahih at-Targhib wat-Tarhib 1/270, Sahih Abi Dawud 3/957, Sahih Ibn Majah 2/331 and Zad al-Ma'ad 2/377
reference.ar: عشرَ مرَّات: النسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 24، وأحمد، برقم 8719، وانظر: صحيح الترغيب والترهيب، 1/272، وتحفة الأخيار لابن باز - رحمه الله -، ص44. مرَّةً واحدةً عندَ الكَسَلِ: أبو داود، برقم 5077، وابن ماجه، برقم 3867، وأحمد، برقم 16583، وانظر: صحيح الترغيب والترهيب، 1/270، وصحيح أبي داود، 3/957، وصحيح ابن ماجه، 2/331، وزاد المعاد، 2/377

la-ilaha-illallah-wahdahu-hundred-times.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
la-ilaha-illallah-wahdahu-hundred-times.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.
la-ilaha-illallah-wahdahu-hundred-times.translation: There is no god but Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things.

virtue.en: Whoever says it one hundred times in a day, it equals for them the freeing of ten slaves; one hundred good deeds are written for them and one hundred bad deeds are erased from them; it is a protection for them from Satan throughout that day until evening; and no one brings anything better than what they bring, except someone who has done more than that.
virtue.ar: من قالها مائة مرة في يوم كانت له عدل عشر رقاب، وكُتِبَ له مائة حسنة، ومُحيت عنه مائة سيئة، وكانت له حرزاً من الشيطان يومه ذلك حتى يمسي، ولم يأت أحد بأفضل مما جاء به إلا أحد عمل أكثر من ذلك

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 4/95 (no. 3293); Muslim 4/2071 (no. 2691)
reference.ar: البخاري، 4/95، برقم 3293، ومسلم، 4/2071، برقم 2691

subhanallahi-wa-bihamdih-adada-khalqih.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
subhanallahi-wa-bihamdih-adada-khalqih.transliteration: Subḥānallāhi wa bi-ḥamdih, ʿadada khalqih, wa riḍā nafsih, wa zinata ʿarshih, wa midāda kalimātih.
subhanallahi-wa-bihamdih-adada-khalqih.translation: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him, as many times as the number of His creatures, as much as pleases Him, as much as the weight of His Throne, and as much as the ink of His words.

reference.ar: مسلم، 4/2090، برقم 2726

allahumma-inni-asaluka-ilman-nafian.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
allahumma-inni-asaluka-ilman-nafian.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka ʿilman nāfiʿā, wa rizqan ṭayyibā, wa ʿamalan mutaqabbalā.
allahumma-inni-asaluka-ilman-nafian.translation: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that benefits, provision that is good, and deeds that are accepted.

reference.en: Ibn as-Sunni in 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah (no. 54); Ibn Majah (no. 925); its chain was graded good by Abd al-Qadir and Shu'ayb al-Arna'ut in their edition of Zad al-Ma'ad 2/375
reference.ar: أخرجه ابن السني في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 54، وابن ماجه، برقم 925، وحسّن إسناده عبد القادر وشعيب الأرناؤوط في تحقيق زاد المعاد، 2/375

astaghfirullah-wa-atubu-ilayh.translation: I ask Allah for forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance.

note.en: One hundred times during the day.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari, with Fath al-Bari 11/101 (no. 6307); Muslim 4/2075 (no. 2702)
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح، 11/101، برقم 6307، ومسلم، 4/2075، برقم 2702

audhu-bi-kalimatillah-at-tammat.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
audhu-bi-kalimatillah-at-tammat.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-kalimātillāhit-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq.
audhu-bi-kalimatillah-at-tammat.translation: I seek refuge in Allah's perfect words from the evil of whatever He has created.

virtue.en: Whoever says it three times in the evening will not be harmed by any venomous sting that night.
virtue.ar: من قالها حين يمسي ثلاث مرات لم تضرّه حُمَة تلك الليلة

reference.en: Ahmad 2/290 (no. 7898); an-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah (no. 590); see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/187, Sahih Ibn Majah 2/266 and Tuhfat al-Akhyar by Ibn Baz, p. 45
reference.ar: أخرجه أحمد، 2/290، برقم 7898، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 590، وانظر: صحيح الترمذي، 3/187، وصحيح ابن ماجه، 2/266، وتحفة الأخيار لابن باز، ص45

allahumma-salli-wa-sallim-ala-nabiyyina-.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
allahumma-salli-wa-sallim-ala-nabiyyina-.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā nabiyyinā Muḥammad.
allahumma-salli-wa-sallim-ala-nabiyyina-.translation: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.

reference.en: At-Tabarani through two chains, one of them good; see Majma' az-Zawa'id 10/120 and Sahih at-Targhib wat-Tarhib 1/273; it is also in Da'if at-Targhib wat-Tarhib (no. 396) and in as-Silsilah ad-Da'ifah (no. 5788), al-Albani's collections of weak narrations
reference.ar: أخرجه الطبراني بإسنادين: أحدهما جيد، انظر: مجمع الزوائد، 10/120، وصحيح الترغيب والترهيب، 1/273، وضعيف الترغيب والترهيب برقم: 396. وفي السلسلة الضعيفة برقم: 5788

reference.en: Muslim 1/414 (no. 591)
reference.ar: مسلم، 1/414، رقم 591

allahumma-antas-salam.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الجَلَالِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
allahumma-antas-salam.transliteration: Allāhumma antas-salāmu wa minkas-salām, tabārakta yā dhal-jalāli wal-ikrām.
allahumma-antas-salam.translation: O Allah, You are Peace, and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.

reference.en: Muslim 1/414 (no. 591); "ya dhal-jalal", with "ya", is the wording of the narrations of Aishah that Muslim gives after it
reference.ar: مسلم، 1/414، رقم 591

la-ilaha-illallah-wahdahu-three-times.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
la-ilaha-illallah-wahdahu-three-times.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.
la-ilaha-illallah-wahdahu-three-times.translation: There is no god but Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 1/255 (no. 844); Muslim 1/414 (no. 593). The three times are an addition from al-Bukhari (no. 6473), which the book prints between square brackets
reference.ar: البخاري، 1/255، برقم 844، ومسلم، 1/414، برقم 593، وما بين المعقوفين زيادة من البخاري، برقم 6473

allahumma-la-mania-lima-atayt.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
allahumma-la-mania-lima-atayt.transliteration: Allāhumma lā māniʿa limā aʿṭayt, wa lā muʿṭiya limā manaʿt, wa lā yanfaʿu dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd.
allahumma-la-mania-lima-atayt.translation: O Allah, none can withhold what You give, and none can give what You withhold, and no fortune avails its owner anything against You.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari 1/255 (no. 844); Muslim 1/414 (no. 593)
reference.ar: البخاري، 1/255، برقم 844، ومسلم، 1/414، برقم 593

la-ilaha-illallah-wa-la-nabudu-illa-iyya.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَلَا نَعْبُدُ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ، لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الفَضْلُ، وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الحَسَنُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الكَافِرُونَ
la-ilaha-illallah-wa-la-nabudu-illa-iyya.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr, lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh, lā ilāha illallāh, wa lā naʿbudu illā iyyāh, lahun-niʿmatu wa lahul-faḍl, wa lahuth-thanāʾul-ḥasan, lā ilāha illallāhu mukhliṣīna lahud-dīna wa law karihal-kāfirūn.
la-ilaha-illallah-wa-la-nabudu-illa-iyya.translation: There is no god but Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things. There is no might and no power except by Allah. There is no god but Allah, and we worship none but Him. His is all blessing and His is all bounty, and to Him belongs beautiful praise. There is no god but Allah; we devote our religion to Him alone, however much the disbelievers may hate it.

reference.en: Muslim 1/415 (no. 594)
reference.ar: مسلم، 1/415، برقم 594

reference.en: Muslim 1/418 (no. 597)
reference.ar: مسلم، 1/418، برقم 597

alhamdulillah.translation: All praise is due to Allah.

reference.en: Muslim 1/418 (no. 597)
reference.ar: مسلم، 1/418، برقم 597

reference.en: Muslim 1/418 (no. 597)
reference.ar: مسلم، 1/418، برقم 597

la-ilaha-illallah-wahdahu-to-complete-a-.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
la-ilaha-illallah-wahdahu-to-complete-a-.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.
la-ilaha-illallah-wahdahu-to-complete-a-.translation: There is no god but Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things.

virtue.en: Whoever says all of this after every prayer has their sins forgiven, even if they are like the foam of the sea.
virtue.ar: من قال ذلك دبر كل صلاة غفرت خطاياه وإن كانت مثل زبد البحر

reference.en: Muslim 1/418 (no. 597)
reference.ar: مسلم، 1/418، برقم 597

after-prayer-al-ikhlas-al-falaq-an-nas.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ
لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ
مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ
وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
مَلِكِ النَّاسِ
إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ
مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ
الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ
مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
after-prayer-al-ikhlas-al-falaq-an-nas.transliteration: Bismillāhir-raḥmānir-raḥīm. Qul huwallāhu aḥad, Allāhuṣ-ṣamad, lam yalid wa lam yūlad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan aḥad. Bismillāhir-raḥmānir-raḥīm. Qul aʿūdhu bi-rabbil-falaq, min sharri mā khalaq, wa min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab, wa min sharrin-naffāthāti fil-ʿuqad, wa min sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad. Bismillāhir-raḥmānir-raḥīm. Qul aʿūdhu bi-rabbin-nās, malikin-nās, ilāhin-nās, min sharril-waswāsil-khannās, alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūrin-nās, minal-jinnati wan-nās.
after-prayer-al-ikhlas-al-falaq-an-nas.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: He is Allah, the One; Allah, the Self-Sufficient on whom all depend. He begot no one, nor was He begotten, and there is no one comparable to Him. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the dawn from the evil of whatever He has created, from the evil of the night's darkness when it sets in, from the evil of those who blow upon knots, and from the evil of an envious one when he envies. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of humankind, the King of humankind, the God of humankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer who whispers into the breasts of humankind, whether of the jinn or of humankind.

note.en: The hadiths cited here say "after every prayer" and give no number, as the edition of the book used here does. Some editions add three times after Fajr and Maghrib, taken from the morning and evening hadith of 'Abdullah ibn Khubayb.

reference.en: Qur'an, Surahs al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq and an-Nas. Abu Dawud 2/86 (no. 1523); at-Tirmidhi (no. 2903); an-Nasa'i 3/68 (no. 1336); see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 2/8. The three surahs are called al-Mu'awwidhat; see Fath al-Bari 9/62
reference.ar: سورة الإخلاص، سورة الفلق، سورة الناس. أبو داود، 2/86، برقم 1523، والترمذي، برقم 2903، والنسائي، 3/68، برقم 1336، وانظر: صحيح الترمذي، 2/8. والسور الثلاث يقال لها: المعوذات. انظر: فتح الباري، 9/62

after-prayer-ayat-al-kursi.arabic:
أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
after-prayer-ayat-al-kursi.transliteration: Aʿūdhu billāhi minash-shayṭānir-rajīm. Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwal-ḥayyul-qayyūm, lā taʾkhudhuhu sinatun wa lā nawm, lahu mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍ, man dhal-ladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahu illā bi-idhnih, yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wa mā khalfahum, wa lā yuḥīṭūna bi-shayʾin min ʿilmihi illā bi-mā shāʾ, wasiʿa kursiyyuhus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, wa lā yaʾūduhu ḥifẓuhumā, wa huwal-ʿaliyyul-ʿaẓīm.
after-prayer-ayat-al-kursi.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan. Allah: there is no god except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Drowsiness does not come over Him, nor does sleep. All that is in the heavens and all that is on the earth is His. Who is there that can intercede before Him except by His leave? He knows what lies ahead of them and what lies behind them, while they grasp nothing of His knowledge beyond what He wills. His Kursi encompasses the heavens and the earth, and safeguarding them both is no burden to Him. He is the Most High, the Magnificent.

virtue.en: Whoever recites it after every prayer, nothing stands between them and entering Paradise but death.
virtue.ar: من قرأها دبر كل صلاة لم يمنعه من دخول الجنة إلا أن يموت

reference.en: An-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah (no. 100); Ibn as-Sunni (no. 121); graded authentic by al-Albani in Sahih al-Jami' 5/339 and as-Silsilah as-Sahihah 2/697 (no. 972). The ayah is no. 255 of Surah al-Baqarah
reference.ar: النسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة، برقم 100، وابن السني، برقم 121، وصححه الألباني في صحيح الجامع، 5/339، وسلسلة الأحاديث الصحيحة، 2/697، برقم 972، والآية رقم 255 من سورة البقرة

la-ilaha-illallah-yuhyi-wa-yumit-ten-tim.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
la-ilaha-illallah-yuhyi-wa-yumit-ten-tim.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, yuḥyī wa yumītu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.
la-ilaha-illallah-yuhyi-wa-yumit-ten-tim.translation: There is no god but Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He has power over all things.

note.en: After the Fajr prayer, while still sitting with the legs folded as in the prayer, before speaking: the condition in at-Tirmidhi's narration.
note.ar: فِي دُبُرِ صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ وَهُوَ ثَانِي رِجْلَيْهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَ

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi 5/515 (no. 3474), after the Fajr prayer, who called it hasan, gharib and sahih, though later scholars differ on its chain; Ahmad 4/227 (no. 17990), after the Maghrib and the Subh prayer; see its takhrij in Zad al-Ma'ad 1/300. After the Maghrib prayer: at-Tirmidhi (no. 3534), who called it hasan gharib
reference.ar: رواه الترمذي، 5/515، برقم 3474، وأحمد، 4/227، برقم 17990، وانظر تخريجه في: زاد المعاد 1/300. والترمذي، برقم 3534

sleep-al-ikhlas-al-falaq-an-nas.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ
لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ
مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ
وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
مَلِكِ النَّاسِ
إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ
مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ
الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ
مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
sleep-al-ikhlas-al-falaq-an-nas.transliteration: Bismillāhir-raḥmānir-raḥīm. Qul huwallāhu aḥad, Allāhuṣ-ṣamad, lam yalid wa lam yūlad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan aḥad. Bismillāhir-raḥmānir-raḥīm. Qul aʿūdhu bi-rabbil-falaq, min sharri mā khalaq, wa min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab, wa min sharrin-naffāthāti fil-ʿuqad, wa min sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad. Bismillāhir-raḥmānir-raḥīm. Qul aʿūdhu bi-rabbin-nās, malikin-nās, ilāhin-nās, min sharril-waswāsil-khannās, alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūrin-nās, minal-jinnati wan-nās.
sleep-al-ikhlas-al-falaq-an-nas.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: He is Allah, the One; Allah, the Self-Sufficient on whom all depend. He begot no one, nor was He begotten, and there is no one comparable to Him. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the dawn from the evil of whatever He has created, from the evil of the night's darkness when it sets in, from the evil of those who blow upon knots, and from the evil of an envious one when he envies. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of humankind, the King of humankind, the God of humankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer who whispers into the breasts of humankind, whether of the jinn or of humankind.

note.en: Put the palms together, blow lightly into them and recite into them. Then wipe with them as much of the body as you can, beginning with the head, the face and the front of the body. Do this three times.
note.ar: يَجْمَعُ كَفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ يَنْفُثُ فِيهِمَا، فَيَقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا. ثُمَّ يَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا مَا اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ يَبْدَأُ بِهِمَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ وَوَجْهِهِ وَمَا أَقْبَلَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ. يفعلُ ذلك ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ

reference.en: Qur'an, Surahs al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq and an-Nas. Al-Bukhari, with Fath al-Bari 9/62 (no. 5017), on doing this at bedtime; Muslim (no. 2192), on reciting them over oneself when ill
reference.ar: سورة الإخلاص، سورة الفلق، سورة الناس. البخاري مع الفتح، 9/62، برقم 5017، ومسلم، برقم 2192

sleep-ayat-al-kursi.arabic:
أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
sleep-ayat-al-kursi.transliteration: Aʿūdhu billāhi minash-shayṭānir-rajīm. Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwal-ḥayyul-qayyūm, lā taʾkhudhuhu sinatun wa lā nawm, lahu mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍ, man dhal-ladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahu illā bi-idhnih, yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wa mā khalfahum, wa lā yuḥīṭūna bi-shayʾin min ʿilmihi illā bi-mā shāʾ, wasiʿa kursiyyuhus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, wa lā yaʾūduhu ḥifẓuhumā, wa huwal-ʿaliyyul-ʿaẓīm.
sleep-ayat-al-kursi.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan. Allah: there is no god except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Drowsiness does not come over Him, nor does sleep. All that is in the heavens and all that is on the earth is His. Who is there that can intercede before Him except by His leave? He knows what lies ahead of them and what lies behind them, while they grasp nothing of His knowledge beyond what He wills. His Kursi encompasses the heavens and the earth, and safeguarding them both is no burden to Him. He is the Most High, the Magnificent.

virtue.en: Whoever recites it on going to bed remains under the protection of a guardian from Allah, and no devil comes near them until morning.
virtue.ar: من قرأها إذا أوى إلى فراشه فإنه لن يزال عليه من الله حافظ ولا يقربه شيطان حتى يصبح

reference.en: Qur'an, Surah al-Baqarah, ayah 255. Al-Bukhari, with Fath al-Bari 4/487 (no. 2311), a mu'allaq report, which al-Bukhari opens with "'Uthman ibn al-Haytham said" rather than with a chain of his own
reference.ar: سورة البقرة، الآية: 255. البخاري مع الفتح، 4/487، برقم 2311

last-two-ayat-of-al-baqarah.arabic:
أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
last-two-ayat-of-al-baqarah.transliteration: Aʿūdhu billāhi minash-shayṭānir-rajīm. Āmanar-rasūlu bi-mā unzila ilayhi min rabbihi wal-muʾminūn, kullun āmana billāhi wa malāʾikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulih, lā nufarriqu bayna aḥadin min rusulih, wa qālū samiʿnā wa aṭaʿnā, ghufrānaka rabbanā wa ilaykal-maṣīr. Lā yukallifullāhu nafsan illā wusʿahā, lahā mā kasabat wa ʿalayhā maktasabat, rabbanā lā tuʾākhidhnā in nasīnā aw akhṭaʾnā, rabbanā wa lā taḥmil ʿalaynā iṣran kamā ḥamaltahu ʿalal-ladhīna min qablinā, rabbanā wa lā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bih, waʿfu ʿannā waghfir lanā warḥamnā, anta mawlānā fanṣurnā ʿalal-qawmil-kāfirīn.
last-two-ayat-of-al-baqarah.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan. The Messenger believes in what has been sent down to him from his Lord, and so do the believers. Each of them believes in Allah, His angels, His Books and His messengers: we make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they say: We hear and we obey; we ask Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the return. Allah lays on no soul a burden beyond what it can bear. In its favour is the good it has earned, and against it the evil it has brought upon itself. Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or fall into error. Our Lord, do not lay on us a burden like the one You laid on those before us. Our Lord, do not make us carry what we have no strength to bear. Pardon us, forgive us and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so help us against the people who disbelieve.

virtue.en: Whoever recites these two ayat at night, they suffice them.
virtue.ar: من قرأهما في ليلة كفتاه

reference.en: Al-Bukhari, with Fath al-Bari 9/94 (no. 4008); Muslim 1/554 (no. 807). The two ayat are 285 and 286 of Surah al-Baqarah
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح، 9/94، برقم 4008، ومسلم، 1/554، برقم 807، والآيتان من سورة البقرة، 285 - 286

bismika-rabbi-wadatu-janbi.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
bismika-rabbi-wadatu-janbi.transliteration: Bismika rabbī waḍaʿtu janbī, wa bika arfaʿuh, fa-in amsakta nafsī farḥamhā, wa in arsaltahā faḥfaẓhā, bi-mā taḥfaẓu bihi ʿibādakaṣ-ṣāliḥīn.
bismika-rabbi-wadatu-janbi.translation: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, and by You I raise it up. If You take my soul, have mercy on it, and if You send it back, protect it with that by which You protect Your righteous servants.

note.en: Al-Bukhari's narration, and Muslim's in like words: when one of you goes to bed, let him dust it off with the inside of his waist-wrap, for he does not know what came onto it after him, then say this. At-Tirmidhi's: when one of you gets up from his bed and then comes back to it, let him dust it off three times with the edge of his waist-wrap, for he does not know what came onto it after him, and when he lies down, let him say this.
note.ar: البخاري: إِذَا أَوَى أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ فَلْيَنْفُضْ فِرَاشَهُ بِدَاخِلَةِ إِزَارِهِ، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَدْرِي مَا خَلَفَهُ عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ. الترمذي: إِذَا قَامَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَنْ فِرَاشِهِ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ فَلْيَنْفُضْهُ بِصَنِفَةِ إِزَارِهِ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَدْرِي مَا خَلَفَهُ عَلَيْهِ بَعْدَهُ فَإِذَا اضْطَجَعَ فَلْيَقُلْ

reference.en: Al-Bukhari, with Fath al-Bari 11/126 (no. 6320); Muslim 4/2084 (no. 2714). With the wording recited here: at-Tirmidhi (no. 3401)
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح، 11/126، برقم 6320. ومسلم، 4/2084، برقم 2714، والترمذي، برقم 3401

allahumma-innaka-khalaqta-nafsi.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا، لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْيَاهَا، إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ العَافِيَةَ
allahumma-innaka-khalaqta-nafsi.transliteration: Allāhumma innaka khalaqta nafsī wa anta tawaffāhā, laka mamātuhā wa maḥyāhā, in aḥyaytahā faḥfaẓhā, wa in amattahā faghfir lahā, Allāhumma innī asʾalukal-ʿāfiyah.
allahumma-innaka-khalaqta-nafsi.translation: O Allah, You created my soul and You take it in death. Its death and its life belong to You. If You keep it alive, protect it, and if You cause it to die, forgive it. O Allah, I ask You for well-being.

reference.en: Muslim 4/2083 (no. 2712); Ahmad, with this wording, 2/79 (no. 5502)
reference.ar: أخرجه مسلم، 4/2083، برقم 2712، وأحمد بلفظه، 2/79، برقم 5502

allahumma-qini-adhabaka.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
allahumma-qini-adhabaka.transliteration: Allāhumma qinī ʿadhābaka yawma tabʿathu ʿibādak.
allahumma-qini-adhabaka.translation: O Allah, shield me from Your punishment on the Day You raise up Your servants.

note.en: When he, may Allah's blessings and peace be upon him, wanted to sleep, he would put his right hand under his cheek and then say this.
note.ar: كان - صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ - إذا أراد أن يرقد وضع يده اليمنى تحت خدِّه، ثم يقول

reference.en: Abu Dawud, with this wording, which has it three times, 4/311 (no. 5045); at-Tirmidhi (no. 3398); see also Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/143 and Sahih Abi Dawud 3/240
reference.ar: أبو داود بلفظه، 4/311، برقم 5045، والترمذي، برقم 3398، وانظر: صحيح الترمذي، 3/143، وصحيح أبي داود، 3/240

bismika-allahumma-amutu-wa-ahya.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari, with Fath al-Bari 11/113 (no. 6324); Muslim 4/2083 (no. 2711)
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح، 11/113، برقم 6324، ومسلم، 4/2083، برقم 2711

reference.en: Al-Bukhari, with Fath al-Bari 7/71 (no. 3705); Muslim 4/2091 (no. 2727)
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح، 7/71، برقم 3705، ومسلم، 4/2091، برقم 2727

sleep-alhamdulillah.translation: All praise is due to Allah.

reference.en: Al-Bukhari, with Fath al-Bari 7/71 (no. 3705); Muslim 4/2091 (no. 2727)
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح، 7/71، برقم 3705، ومسلم، 4/2091، برقم 2727

virtue.en: Whoever says all of this on going to bed, it is better for them than a servant.
virtue.ar: من قال ذلك عندما يأوي إلى فراشه كان خيراً له من خادم

reference.en: Al-Bukhari, with Fath al-Bari 7/71 (no. 3705); Muslim 4/2091 (no. 2727)
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح، 7/71، برقم 3705، ومسلم، 4/2091، برقم 2727

allahumma-rabbas-samawatis-sab.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ، وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
allahumma-rabbas-samawatis-sab.transliteration: Allāhumma rabbas-samāwātis-sabʿi wa rabbal-arḍ, wa rabbal-ʿarshil-ʿaẓīm, rabbanā wa rabba kulli shayʾ, fāliqal-ḥabbi wan-nawā, wa munzilat-tawrāti wal-injīl, wal-furqān, aʿūdhu bika min sharri kulli shayʾin anta ākhidhun bi-nāṣiyatih. Allāhumma antal-awwalu fa-laysa qablaka shayʾ, wa antal-ākhiru fa-laysa baʿdaka shayʾ, wa antaẓ-ẓāhiru fa-laysa fawqaka shayʾ, wa antal-bāṭinu fa-laysa dūnaka shayʾ, iqḍi ʿannad-dayna wa aghninā minal-faqr.
allahumma-rabbas-samawatis-sab.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the mighty Throne, our Lord and the Lord of all things, who splits open the grain and the date-stone, who sent down the Torah, the Gospel and the Criterion: I seek refuge in You from the evil of everything whose forelock You hold. O Allah, You are the First, and there is nothing before You; You are the Last, and there is nothing after You; You are the Manifest, and there is nothing above You; You are the Hidden, and there is nothing beyond You. Settle our debts for us and free us from poverty.

reference.en: Muslim 4/2084 (no. 2713); "seven" is in the narration of Fatimah via al-A'mash there, and in at-Tirmidhi (no. 3481)
reference.ar: مسلم، 4/2084، برقم 2713، والترمذي، برقم 3481

alhamdu-lillahil-ladhi-atamana.arabic: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَكَفَانَا وَآوَانَا فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لَا كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلَا مُؤْوِيَ
alhamdu-lillahil-ladhi-atamana.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī aṭʿamanā wa saqānā wa kafānā wa āwānā fa-kam mimman lā kāfiya lahu wa lā muʾwī.
alhamdu-lillahil-ladhi-atamana.translation: All praise is due to Allah, who has fed us and given us drink, who has sufficed us and sheltered us; for how many there are who have no one to suffice them and no one to shelter them.

reference.ar: مسلم، 4/2085، برقم 2715

allahumma-aslamtu-nafsi-ilayk.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
allahumma-aslamtu-nafsi-ilayk.transliteration: Allāhumma aslamtu nafsī ilayk, wa fawwaḍtu amrī ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhī ilayk, wa aljaʾtu ẓahrī ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, lā maljaʾa wa lā manjā minka illā ilayk, āmantu bi-kitābikal-ladhī anzalta wa bi-nabiyyikal-ladhī arsalt.
allahumma-aslamtu-nafsi-ilayk.translation: O Allah, I have surrendered myself to You, entrusted my affairs to You, turned my face to You and made You the support of my back, out of longing for You and fear of You. There is no refuge and no escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book which You sent down and in Your Prophet whom You sent.

note.en: When you go to your bed, perform ablution as you do for prayer, then lie down on your right side and say this.
note.ar: إذا أخذت مضجعك فتوضأ وضوءك للصلاة، ثم اضطجع على شقك الأيمن، ثم قل

virtue.en: If you die, you die upon the fitrah, the natural way of Islam.
virtue.ar: فإن مُتَّ مُتَّ على الفطرة

reference.en: Al-Bukhari, with Fath al-Bari 11/113 (no. 6313); Muslim 4/2081 (no. 2710)
reference.ar: البخاري مع الفتح، 11/113، برقم 6313، ومسلم، 4/2081، برقم 2710

surah-as-sajdah.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
الم
تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ ۚ بَلْ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا مَا أَتَاهُمْ مِنْ نَذِيرٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ ۖ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ دُونِهِ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ ۚ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ فِي يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
ذَٰلِكَ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
الَّذِي أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ ۖ وَبَدَأَ خَلْقَ الْإِنْسَانِ مِنْ طِينٍ
ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهُ مِنْ سُلَالَةٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ مَهِينٍ
ثُمَّ سَوَّاهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِنْ رُوحِهِ ۖ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَا تَشْكُرُونَ
وَقَالُوا أَإِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَإِنَّا لَفِي خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ كَافِرُونَ
۞ قُلْ يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ الَّذِي وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ
وَلَوْ تَرَىٰ إِذِ الْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُو رُءُوسِهِمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَا أَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَارْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ
وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَآتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدَاهَا وَلَٰكِنْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ مِنِّي لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
فَذُوقُوا بِمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَا إِنَّا نَسِينَاكُمْ ۖ وَذُوقُوا عَذَابَ الْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
إِنَّمَا يُؤْمِنُ بِآيَاتِنَا الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا بِهَا خَرُّوا سُجَّدًا وَسَبَّحُوا بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ ۩
تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ
فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
أَفَمَنْ كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَنْ كَانَ فَاسِقًا ۚ لَا يَسْتَوُونَ
أَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ الْمَأْوَىٰ نُزُلًا بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ فَسَقُوا فَمَأْوَاهُمُ النَّارُ ۖ كُلَّمَا أَرَادُوا أَنْ يَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا أُعِيدُوا فِيهَا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ ذُوقُوا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُمْ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْأَدْنَىٰ دُونَ الْعَذَابِ الْأَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ ذُكِّرَ بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِ ثُمَّ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا ۚ إِنَّا مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ مُنْتَقِمُونَ
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ فَلَا تَكُنْ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِنْ لِقَائِهِ ۖ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ هُدًى لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ
وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوا ۖ وَكَانُوا بِآيَاتِنَا يُوقِنُونَ
إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِي مَسَاكِنِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ ۖ أَفَلَا يَسْمَعُونَ
أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا نَسُوقُ الْمَاءَ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ الْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهِ زَرْعًا تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ أَنْعَامُهُمْ وَأَنْفُسُهُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يُبْصِرُونَ
وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا الْفَتْحُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
قُلْ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ لَا يَنْفَعُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا إِيمَانُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْظَرُونَ
فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَانْتَظِرْ إِنَّهُمْ مُنْتَظِرُونَ
surah-as-sajdah.transliteration: Bismillāhir-raḥmānir-raḥīm. Alif lām mīm. Tanzīlul-kitābi lā rayba fīhi min rabbil-ʿālamīn. Am yaqūlūnaftarāh, bal huwal-ḥaqqu min rabbika li-tundhira qawman mā atāhum min nadhīrin min qablika laʿallahum yahtadūn. Allāhul-ladhī khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa wa mā baynahumā fī sittati ayyāmin thummastawā ʿalal-ʿarsh, mā lakum min dūnihi min waliyyin wa lā shafīʿ, afalā tatadhakkarūn. Yudabbirul-amra minas-samāʾi ilal-arḍi thumma yaʿruju ilayhi fī yawmin kāna miqdāruhu alfa sanatin mimmā taʿuddūn. Dhālika ʿālimul-ghaybi wash-shahādatil-ʿazīzur-raḥīm. Alladhī aḥsana kulla shayʾin khalaqah, wa badaʾa khalqal-insāni min ṭīn. Thumma jaʿala naslahu min sulālatin min māʾin mahīn. Thumma sawwāhu wa nafakha fīhi min rūḥih, wa jaʿala lakumus-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afʾidah, qalīlan mā tashkurūn. Wa qālū aʾidhā ḍalalnā fil-arḍi aʾinnā la-fī khalqin jadīd, bal hum bi-liqāʾi rabbihim kāfirūn. Qul yatawaffākum malakul-mawtil-ladhī wukkila bikum thumma ilā rabbikum turjaʿūn. Wa law tarā idhil-mujrimūna nākisū ruʾūsihim ʿinda rabbihim, rabbanā abṣarnā wa samiʿnā farjiʿnā naʿmal ṣāliḥan innā mūqinūn. Wa law shiʾnā la-ātaynā kulla nafsin hudāhā wa lākin ḥaqqal-qawlu minnī la-amlaʾanna jahannama minal-jinnati wan-nāsi ajmaʿīn. Fa-dhūqū bi-mā nasītum liqāʾa yawmikum hādhā innā nasīnākum, wa dhūqū ʿadhābal-khuldi bi-mā kuntum taʿmalūn. Innamā yuʾminu bi-āyātinal-ladhīna idhā dhukkirū bihā kharrū sujjadan wa sabbaḥū bi-ḥamdi rabbihim wa hum lā yastakbirūn. Tatajāfā junūbuhum ʿanil-maḍājiʿi yadʿūna rabbahum khawfan wa ṭamaʿan wa mimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn. Fa-lā taʿlamu nafsun mā ukhfiya lahum min qurrati aʿyunin jazāʾan bi-mā kānū yaʿmalūn. A-fa-man kāna muʾminan ka-man kāna fāsiqā, lā yastawūn. Ammal-ladhīna āmanū wa ʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti fa-lahum jannātul-maʾwā nuzulan bi-mā kānū yaʿmalūn. Wa ammal-ladhīna fasaqū fa-maʾwāhumun-nār, kullamā arādū an yakhrujū minhā uʿīdū fīhā wa qīla lahum dhūqū ʿadhāban-nāril-ladhī kuntum bihi tukadhdhibūn. Wa la-nudhīqannahum minal-ʿadhābil-adnā dūnal-ʿadhābil-akbari laʿallahum yarjiʿūn. Wa man aẓlamu mimman dhukkira bi-āyāti rabbihi thumma aʿraḍa ʿanhā, innā minal-mujrimīna muntaqimūn. Wa laqad ātaynā Mūsal-kitāba fa-lā takun fī miryatin min liqāʾih, wa jaʿalnāhu hudan li-banī Isrāʾīl. Wa jaʿalnā minhum aʾimmatan yahdūna bi-amrinā lammā ṣabarū, wa kānū bi-āyātinā yūqinūn. Inna rabbaka huwa yafṣilu baynahum yawmal-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn. Awalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknā min qablihim minal-qurūni yamshūna fī masākinihim, inna fī dhālika la-āyāt, afalā yasmaʿūn. Awalam yaraw annā nasūqul-māʾa ilal-arḍil-juruzi fa-nukhriju bihi zarʿan taʾkulu minhu anʿāmuhum wa anfusuhum, afalā yubṣirūn. Wa yaqūlūna matā hādhal-fatḥu in kuntum ṣādiqīn. Qul yawmal-fatḥi lā yanfaʿul-ladhīna kafarū īmānuhum wa lā hum yunẓarūn. Fa-aʿriḍ ʿanhum wantaẓir innahum muntaẓirūn.
surah-as-sajdah.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Alif. Lam. Mim. The sending down of the Book, in which there is no doubt, is from the Lord of all the worlds. Or do they say, "He has made it up"? No, it is the truth from your Lord, for you to warn a people to whom no warner came before you, so that they may be guided. It is Allah who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six days, then rose over the Throne. Apart from Him you have no protector and no intercessor. Will you not, then, take heed? He directs every affair from the heaven to the earth, then it ascends to Him in a day whose length is a thousand years of what you count. That is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Almighty, the Most Merciful, who made excellent everything He created, and began the creation of man from clay, then made his descendants from an extract of a humble fluid, then shaped him and breathed into him of His spirit, and gave you hearing, sight and hearts. Little thanks do you give. They say, "When we have been lost in the earth, shall we really be created anew?" In truth, they deny that they will meet their Lord. Say: "The angel of death who has been put in charge of you will take your souls, then to your Lord you will be brought back." If only you could see the guilty with heads bowed low in the presence of their Lord: "Our Lord, we have seen and heard. Return us, and we shall act righteously; we are now certain." If it had been Our will, each soul would have received its guidance from Us; but the word from Me has come to pass: "I shall fill Hell with jinn and humans together." So taste, for having forgotten the meeting of this Day of yours. We too have forgotten you. Taste the punishment that lasts for ever, for what you used to do. Only those believe in Our signs who, when they are reminded of them, fall down prostrating and glorify their Lord with His praise, and are not arrogant. Their sides keep away from their beds as they call on their Lord in fear and in hope, and they spend from what We have provided for them. No soul knows what joy for the eyes has been kept hidden for them, as a reward for what they used to do. Is the one who believes like the one who defies Allah? They are not equal. As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, the Gardens of Refuge are theirs, a welcome for what they used to do. As for those who defy Allah, their refuge is the Fire. Every time they want to leave it they are put back into it, and they are told: "Taste the punishment of the Fire that you used to deny." We will make them taste the lesser punishment before the greater punishment, so that they may turn back. Who does greater wrong than one who is reminded of the signs of his Lord and then turns away from them? We will exact retribution from the guilty. We gave Moses the Book, so be in no doubt about meeting him, and We made it a guidance for the Children of Israel. We made from among them leaders who guided by Our command when they had been patient and were certain of Our signs. Your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning the things over which they used to differ. Is it not a lesson to them how many generations We destroyed before them, through whose dwellings they now walk? In that there are signs. Will they not, then, listen? Do they not see how We drive the water to the barren land and bring out with it crops from which their livestock and they themselves eat? Will they not, then, see? They say: "When will this Victory come, if you are telling the truth?" Say: "On the Day of Victory their belief will not help those who disbelieved, nor will they be given more time." So turn aside from them, and wait, as they also wait.

note.en: Ayah 15 is a place of prostration of recitation (sajdat at-tilawah), marked by the sign at its end.

reference.en: Qur'an, Surah as-Sajdah. At-Tirmidhi (no. 3404); an-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah (no. 707); see also Sahih al-Jami' 4/255
