surah-al-mulk.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَاةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفُورُ
الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا ۖ مَا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلْقِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ مِنْ تَفَاوُتٍ ۖ فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِنْ فُطُورٍ
ثُمَّ ارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنْقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ الْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ
وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَاهَا رُجُومًا لِلشَّيَاطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ السَّعِيرِ
وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ
إِذَا أُلْقُوا فِيهَا سَمِعُوا لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِيَ تَفُورُ
تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَا أُلْقِيَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ
قَالُوا بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَاءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ كَبِيرٍ
وَقَالُوا لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِي أَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ
فَاعْتَرَفُوا بِذَنْبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِأَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَيْبِ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
وَأَسِرُّوا قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ اجْهَرُوا بِهِ ۖ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ
أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ
هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَامْشُوا فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا مِنْ رِزْقِهِ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
أَأَمِنْتُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ أَنْ يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ الْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ
أَمْ أَمِنْتُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ أَنْ يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَافَّاتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا الرَّحْمَٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ بَصِيرٌ
أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا الَّذِي هُوَ جُنْدٌ لَكُمْ يَنْصُرُكُمْ مِنْ دُونِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ إِنِ الْكَافِرُونَ إِلَّا فِي غُرُورٍ
أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا الَّذِي يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُ ۚ بَلْ لَجُّوا فِي عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ
أَفَمَنْ يَمْشِي مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِ أَهْدَىٰ أَمَّنْ يَمْشِي سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِي أَنْشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَا تَشْكُرُونَ
قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
قُلْ إِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ
فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيئَتْ وُجُوهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَدَّعُونَ
قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِيَ اللَّهُ وَمَنْ مَعِيَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَنْ يُجِيرُ الْكَافِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
قُلْ هُوَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ آمَنَّا بِهِ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَاؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَنْ يَأْتِيكُمْ بِمَاءٍ مَعِينٍ
surah-al-mulk.transliteration: Bismillāhir-raḥmānir-raḥīm. Tabārakal-ladhī bi-yadihil-mulku wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. Alladhī khalaqal-mawta wal-ḥayāta li-yabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ʿamalā, wa huwal-ʿazīzul-ghafūr. Alladhī khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqā, mā tarā fī khalqir-raḥmāni min tafāwut, farjiʿil-baṣara hal tarā min fuṭūr. Thummarjiʿil-baṣara karratayni yanqalib ilaykal-baṣaru khāsiʾan wa huwa ḥasīr. Wa laqad zayyannas-samāʾad-dunyā bi-maṣābīḥa wa jaʿalnāhā rujūman lish-shayāṭīn, wa aʿtadnā lahum ʿadhābas-saʿīr. Wa lil-ladhīna kafarū bi-rabbihim ʿadhābu jahannam, wa biʾsal-maṣīr. Idhā ulqū fīhā samiʿū lahā shahīqan wa hiya tafūr. Takādu tamayyazu minal-ghayẓ, kullamā ulqiya fīhā fawjun saʾalahum khazanatuhā alam yaʾtikum nadhīr. Qālū balā qad jāʾanā nadhīrun fa-kadhdhabnā wa qulnā mā nazzalallāhu min shayʾin in antum illā fī ḍalālin kabīr. Wa qālū law kunnā nasmaʿu aw naʿqilu mā kunnā fī aṣḥābis-saʿīr. Faʿtarafū bi-dhanbihim fa-suḥqan li-aṣḥābis-saʿīr. Innal-ladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi lahum maghfiratun wa ajrun kabīr. Wa asirrū qawlakum awijharū bih, innahu ʿalīmun bi-dhātiṣ-ṣudūr. Alā yaʿlamu man khalaqa wa huwal-laṭīful-khabīr. Huwal-ladhī jaʿala lakumul-arḍa dhalūlan famshū fī manākibihā wa kulū min rizqih, wa ilayhin-nushūr. Aʾamintum man fis-samāʾi an yakhsifa bikumul-arḍa fa-idhā hiya tamūr. Am amintum man fis-samāʾi an yursila ʿalaykum ḥāṣibā, fa-sataʿlamūna kayfa nadhīr. Wa laqad kadhdhabal-ladhīna min qablihim fa-kayfa kāna nakīr. Awalam yaraw ilaṭ-ṭayri fawqahum ṣāffātin wa yaqbiḍn, mā yumsikuhunna illar-raḥmān, innahu bi-kulli shayʾin baṣīr. Amman hādhal-ladhī huwa jundun lakum yanṣurukum min dūnir-raḥmān, inil-kāfirūna illā fī ghurūr. Amman hādhal-ladhī yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqah, bal lajjū fī ʿutuwwin wa nufūr. A-fa-man yamshī mukibban ʿalā wajhihi ahdā amman yamshī sawiyyan ʿalā ṣirāṭin mustaqīm. Qul huwal-ladhī anshaʾakum wa jaʿala lakumus-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afʾidah, qalīlan mā tashkurūn. Qul huwal-ladhī dharaʾakum fil-arḍi wa ilayhi tuḥsharūn. Wa yaqūlūna matā hādhal-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīn. Qul innamal-ʿilmu ʿindallāhi wa innamā ana nadhīrun mubīn. Fa-lammā raʾawhu zulfatan sīʾat wujūhul-ladhīna kafarū wa qīla hādhal-ladhī kuntum bihi taddaʿūn. Qul araʾaytum in ahlakaniyallāhu wa man maʿiya aw raḥimanā fa-man yujīrul-kāfirīna min ʿadhābin alīm. Qul huwar-raḥmānu āmannā bihi wa ʿalayhi tawakkalnā, fa-sataʿlamūna man huwa fī ḍalālin mubīn. Qul araʾaytum in aṣbaḥa māʾukum ghawran fa-man yaʾtīkum bi-māʾin maʿīn.
surah-al-mulk.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Blessed is He in whose hand is the dominion, and He has power over all things, who created death and life to test which of you is best in deeds. He is the Almighty, the Most Forgiving, who created seven heavens, one above another. You see no flaw in the creation of the Most Gracious. Look again: do you see any crack? Then look again, and again: your sight will come back to you humbled and weary. We have adorned the nearest heaven with lamps and made them missiles to drive away the devils, and We have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze. For those who disbelieve in their Lord there is the punishment of Hell, and how evil a destination it is. When they are thrown into it they will hear it drawing in its breath as it boils, almost bursting with fury. Every time a crowd is thrown into it, its keepers will ask them: "Did no warner come to you?" They will say: "Yes, a warner did come to us, but we denied him and said, 'Allah has sent nothing down; you are only in great error.'" And they will say: "Had we listened or used our reason, we would not be among the people of the Blaze." So they will confess their sin. Far away, then, be the people of the Blaze. Those who fear their Lord though they cannot see Him will have forgiveness and a great reward. Keep what you say secret or say it openly: He knows well what is in the hearts. Does He who created not know, when He is the Subtle, the All-Aware? It is He who made the earth easy for you to tread, so walk in its tracts and eat of His provision; and to Him is the rising from the dead. Do you feel safe from Him who is above the heaven, that He will not make the earth swallow you up as it quakes? Or do you feel safe from Him who is above the heaven, that He will not send against you a storm of stones? Then you will know how My warning is. Those who came before them denied the truth as well, and how severe was My reproach! Do they not see the birds above them, spreading their wings and folding them? None holds them up but the Most Gracious. He sees all things. Who is it that could be an army for you, to help you, apart from the Most Gracious? The disbelievers are in nothing but delusion. Who is it that could provide for you, if He held back His provision? Yet they persist in arrogance and aversion. Is one who walks bent over on his face better guided, or one who walks upright on a straight path? Say: "It is He who brought you into being and gave you hearing, sight and hearts. Little thanks do you give." Say: "It is He who spread you over the earth, and to Him you will be gathered." They say: "When will this promise come, if you are telling the truth?" Say: "The knowledge of it is with Allah alone, and I am only a plain warner." When they see it close at hand, the faces of those who disbelieved will be stricken with grief, and it will be said: "This is what you used to ask for." Say: "Consider this: whether Allah destroys me and those with me or has mercy on us, who will protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?" Say: "He is the Most Gracious. We believe in Him, and in Him we put our trust. You will come to know who is in plain error." Say: "Consider this: if your water were to sink deep into the earth, who then could bring you flowing water?"

reference.en: Qur'an, Surah al-Mulk. At-Tirmidhi (no. 3404); an-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah (no. 707); see also Sahih al-Jami' 4/255

la-ilaha-illallah.translation: There is no god but Allah.

virtue.en: The best supplication is "Al-hamdu lillah", and the best remembrance is "La ilaha illallah".
virtue.ar: إِنَّ أَفْضَلَ الدُّعَاءِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَأَفْضَلَ الذِّكْرِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ

reference.en: At-Tirmidhi 5/462 (no. 3383); Ibn Majah 2/1249 (no. 3800); al-Hakim 1/503, who graded it authentic, and adh-Dhahabi agreed; see also Sahih al-Jami' 1/362
